model: JMWL-Series 30-70 Ton Modular Water-to-Water Heat Pump
applies_to: Johnson Controls JMWL-Series 30-70 ton modular water-to-water heat pump modules with the factory master controller.
summary: The JMWL-Series is a modular water-to-water heat pump (chiller/heater) from Johnson Controls. Each module's master controller exposes about 300 objects over BACnet MS/TP: physical inputs and outputs (AI, AO, BI, BO), status, setpoint and alarm values (AV, BV) and a few multistate values for model, refrigerant, valve options and unit mode. The BAS enables cooling or heating through two BAS command BVs and writes the leaving water setpoints.
notes: Access comes from the Read Only column: checked points are read-only, unchecked points are shown writable.
Object names end in _1 for module 1; the table also gives Modbus registers and N2 addresses, which are not listed here. Device ID is printed as DEV:2460xx.
BALM alarm objects are listed as BV; BMSV objects as MV.
Descriptions are the table's Name column. The table's Note column flags physical I/O (1), key status (2), BAS commands (3), alarm resets (4) and system alarms (5).
Source: BACnet, Modbus, N2 Points List, manual pages 37-42.

source.title: JMWL-Series 30-70 Tons Water Source Heat Pump Installation, Operation, and Maintenance Manual

integration.summary: Make sure the local cool and heat enable inputs are open, write the leaving water setpoint (cool_temp_stp_1, 42-62 °F, or heat_temp_stp_1, 80-135 °F), then set cool_enable_bas_1 (BV 52) or heat_enable_bas_1 (BV 53) on and the other off. The module opens its valves, proves load and source flow (BV 9, BV 73, BV 38) and starts the run_cool or run_heat sequence.

minimum_points.name: cool_enable_bas_1
minimum_points.why: Cooling enable from BAS (heat enable off)

minimum_points.name: heat_enable_bas_1
minimum_points.why: Heating enable from BAS (cool enable off)

minimum_points.name: flow_1
minimum_points.why: Load and source flow both proven

integration.enable: With the local dig_cool_enable_1 and dig_heat_enable_1 inputs open, BV 52 cool_enable_bas_1 or BV 53 heat_enable_bas_1 starts the module in cooling or heating; only one should be on.
setup: MS/TP baud is set with DIP switches 1 and 2 on the controller.
BACnet network numbers and device instances are set from the controller's FN(0) and FN(4) menus.
gotchas: Physical outputs (BO, AO) are not marked read-only in the table; writing them overrides the module's own control.
